sources.title: GitHub - imriadh/Disaster_Tweet_Classifier: This model uses TF-IDF ...
sources.snippet: A simple, well-documented example project that uses TF‑IDF features with a Linear Support Vector Machine (LinearSVC) to classify whether a tweet describes a real disaster. This repository contains data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation code used for the "Real or Not? NLP with Disaster Tweets" problem.
